primitives.name: Scoring Action Count
primitives.verbatim_quote: - (b) New scoring rules: basketball under a "every scoring action = 1 point" rule (ground truth = count of scoring actions); player-affiliation swaps (2 players/team swapped in the roster table, pbp unchanged; ground truth recomputed under new affiliations).
primitives.assumptions: Each scoring event contributes uniformly to total score; ground truth is preserved under rule changes.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When player affiliations are swapped, N_{\text{score}} recalculated based on updated roster.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's probabilistic scoring model where each event is a Bernoulli trial with outcome dependent on play description.
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy of predicted N_{\text{score}} against actual counts under adversarial rule changes.

primitives.name: Play Sequence Shuffle
primitives.verbatim_quote: - (c) Scrambled narratives: play-by-plays shuffled (timestamps preserved); non-scoring-play density varied by duplicating (p ∈ {+20%, +50%}) or removing (p ∈ {-20%, -50%}) non-scoring plays; NFL variant: players renamed to science-ficti
primitives.assumptions: Temporal structure preserved; non-scoring plays influence narrative coherence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When p ∈ {-50%, -20%}, model performance degrades due to reduced context.

layer2.mapping: Represents a noise kernel applied to the input sequence that tests robustness of LLM's contextual understanding.
layer2.telemetry: Drop in ΔPoints when non-scoring play density varies by ±20% to ±50%.

primitives.name: Game Summary Fill-In
primitives.verbatim_quote: - (d) Game-summary fill-in: LLM builds an internal JSON working memory in three steps (create → enrich + self-reflect on sufficiency → populate from pbp), then fills masked key statistics in real ESPN recaps; accuracy measured per stat type.
primitives.assumptions: LLM constructs internal working memory to retrieve and populate masked stats accurately.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when LLM hallucinates fields or fails to populate correctly.

layer2.mapping: Mirrors GSE’s content generation pipeline where LLMs must synthesize structured outputs from raw narratives.
layer2.telemetry: Exact-match rate on 12-field JSON stat object across 50 games.

These are formalized as stochastic transformations on a temporal sequence of plays. The scoring action count maps to a discrete counting process, while shuffle introduces a random permutation kernel affecting temporal coherence. The fill-in task models a structured retrieval problem where LLMs must construct internal representations from partial inputs. Each primitive defines a regime of failure: miscounting under rule changes, hallucination under shuffled data, and incorrect synthesis under missing data. The mathematical duality lies in treating these as inverse problems—where the ground truth is known but the model's response must be constrained to match it.
